decision_scope: Use the pinned generative-model design as a proposal reference; defer enabled integration.

primary_evidence.anchor: Eighteen pinned original blobs, dependencies and genuine DECI paper

behavioral_oracle.anchor: Four exact reference families; no upstream execution

rationale: Useful explicit structural-function, intervention and factual-noise abstractions.
Selected graph sampling needs a DAG acceptance boundary; model conditionality must survive any graph averaging.
Selected vector ATE scoring needs a component-preserving reference and native verification.
Dependencies, test configuration and historical extensions do not establish a qualified current adapter.

alternatives.reason: Unverified runtime and semantic acceptance conditions.
Preserve upstream model while validating explicit scientific and output boundaries.
Neural/noise/distribution/training maintenance and numerical equivalence costs are unjustified by a measured advantage.
Supports a concrete proposal and exact acceptance examples now.
Scoped problems have explicit test/repair routes; no general infeasibility follows.

alternatives.route: supplied graph or graph-class effect analysis
alternatives.reason: Keeps structural uncertainty explicit and can avoid unsupported learned-model certainty.

owner_obligations.scientific: Own structural identifiability, causal sufficiency, variable meaning and declared target.
owner_obligations.integration: Own dimensions, interventions, DAG checks, rejected draws, unit conversion and failure accounting.
owner_obligations.runtime: Own resolved installation, dependency notices, reproducibility and update review.
owner_obligations.evaluation: Own independent public/generated references, correct component scoring and declared uncertainty targets.

costs_to_measure: Oracle maintenance, conversion and requalification after updates
revisit_trigger: Resolve an executable pinned environment, verify independent semantic fixtures, repair or constrain vector scoring, and qualify graph acceptance and conversion before enabling a narrow adapter.
limitations: Selected pinned source and genuine primary-paper review; no Causica import, fit, sampler or upstream test execution.
Exact source-trace references establish specified semantic problems, not their frequency in trained models.
No finite graph/effect coverage, identified bank model, deployment qualification or integration capability is awarded.
Whole dependency rights, compatible installation, model/optimization behavior and adapters require a public/generated prototype.
Broader software coverage, whole-manuscript depth and rendered visual acceptance remain open.
